title: Art Critique Session
description:
· Send to a Friend Art Critique Session
Through Tuesday, December 31, 2013
Saladino Studio

official website

$25 per session.

Do you want to paint with confidence, making your paintings the best they can be? If you work alone, you may lack the feedback needed to see your work objectively. Are you open to discussion about your work in front of other artists and willing to share your thoughts about it and others' work, as well? Consider a critique session where:
We will critique each participant's work in every session. You can participate at the level you want, getting more or less input.
We will work in an atmosphere of constructive cooperation and support.
We'll work to develop your skills in presenting your work to galleries.
Sessions will include advice on proper matting/framing for optimum appeal.
"Saladino is interested in how things are built, and he incorporates the idea of enclosure as a way of describing the interface between the natural and built environments, or the relationship between representational and abstract forms." Suzanne Deats, arts writer, author and editor
